source_assessment.classification: source trace and safeguards, no runtime claim
source_assessment.analysis: Frame zero yields AnimationElapsed::ZERO and other frames use the configured locomotion sample interval. The capture sequence advances a typed sample tick with a defined wrap operation, passes elapsed and tick through checked controller input and projection, and sets its procedural clock; separate native fixed-clock admission was assessed in q2300. Errors from facing and controller projection are converted into rejected capture admission; the action expect calls occur earlier. This source trace does not establish runtime scheduling, numeric parity, successful rendering, or all sample-rate ingress.

source_assessment.classification: bounded producer safeguard with broader admitted-constructor question
source_assessment.analysis: CaptureSequence::new constructs a plan through selected built-in paths or capture_plan and starts its tick at zero. Authored quickstep plan calls shown use Vec2::X and Vec2::NEG_X; QuickstepDirection::new requires a finite normalizable vector before DodgeSpec::quickstep succeeds. The quickstep_scenario helper itself accepts a raw Vec2 within animation_viewer, and PlannedFrame is visible to its parent module; if an actually supported caller supplied a zero/nonfinite direction to a frame classified quickstep, the direction expect would fail. No such supported caller or product failure is shown. A selected unknown scenario that yields an empty plan reaches an assertion, but supported scenario policy and actual input ingress are not resolved.

source_assessment.classification: conditional source-level contract question; not a witnessed defect or new count
source_assessment.analysis: At quickstep scenario frame zero begin_capture_action attempts a dodge regardless of current action kind; begin_dodge rejects a downed body, active posture transition, or already-Dodge action. If the same quickstep frame were driven again before applied while its skeleton remained in Dodge, the second begin_dodge would return ActionBusy and the expect would panic. The source does not establish a supported state or retry with those conditions, an intervening action update, or an actual panic. On scenario change the shown driver resets the first encountered subject skeleton; relevant subject cardinality and schedules remain open.

source_assessment.classification: counterevidence to an unqualified ordinary-retry claim
source_assessment.analysis: The two authored quickstep identities supply Quickstep without the Dive, posture-transition or RaisedTapStop properties and have no required motion. Their shown scenario-change path does not assign warmup for those features. When warmup is zero and prior operations succeed, ready_for_frame therefore passes on that shown frame; no repeated drive is established merely from q2303 readiness. Retained warmup from other state, alternate internal frame producers, subject multiplicity and actual event scheduling have not been exhaustively excluded.

source_assessment.classification: conditional operation observation, no distinct count or runtime reachability
source_assessment.analysis: Tick advance wraps, while action deadlines saturate. An action started at MAX receives a saturated contact; ActionTimeline clamps the resulting zero preparation to one and, if the timeline is subsequently sampled at MAX, returns Complete because its end saturates to MAX. The shown begin methods do not reject solely because contact equals start; therefore tick saturation alone does not support the proposed transition-expect panic. Whether this astronomical state is reachable, the timeline is sampled there, or this boundary has an observable impact is unproved.
